home.badge: 🚀 The config layer for admin CRUD · Vue 2 / Vue 3 / Ant Design Vue
home.title: ES-Plus
home.tagline1: The config layer for admin CRUD
home.tagline2: One config · three renderers · compiles on generation
home.comparisonSubtitle: Same page, same scope: 76.5% less markup and event glue code
home.crossSubtitle: Switch one import — the same JSON config renders across all three, at zero cost.
home.feature1Desc: Roughly 30 lines of JSON replace the whole page template: query / reset / pagination / fetching are all handled by config, cutting markup and event glue code by 77%.
home.feature2Desc: EsForm nested in EsTable auto-syncs search / reset / pagination — zero event handlers.
home.feature3Desc: Vue 3 + Element Plus, Vue 2 + Element UI, and Vue 3 + Ant Design Vue share the same JSON config — migrate progressively at zero cost.
home.feature4Desc: JSON Schema constraints + a CI compile matrix — AI-generated code actually runs.
home.esFormDesc: Advanced form — configurable field definitions, conditional validation, async data loading.
home.esTableDesc: Advanced table — configurable columns, auto pagination, request integration.
home.useDialogDesc: Programmatic dialog hook — JSX render, form integration, nested dialogs.
home.esCrudPageDesc: Advanced CRUD component — one schema generates a full query form + table + multi-dialog page.
home.comparisonNote: Every figure above is measured by a build script from the two files shown in this section — not an estimate: template lines + handle*/fetch* event & fetch functions 115 → 27 (-76.5%); whole-file non-empty lines 136 → 76 (-44.1%). Field and column declarations are written on both sides, so they are excluded. Source: docs/brand/one-config/.
